skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Other Side of Siracusa
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/The Other Side of Siracusa. Does he not occasionally wear a plain jacket and hoodie instead of a tailored suit, and sit-down at a not-quite traditional Siracusan restaurant?
skins.quote: He wanted to see with his own eyes the side of Siracusa that was not so Siracusan. When he noticed the gazes of those assessing him from the corners of the restaurant, he realized that such a Siracusa does not yet exist.
